programs.title: Mojo Swoptops
programs.desc: A shark in Swoppiton? Mojo and Bo go on a fishing trip to find out!

programs.title: Hey Duggee
programs.desc: Betty and Sargent Ant just want perfection, but no one seems to be listening to their shouting! They need a lesson in diplomacy to learn how to speak in a more sensitive way.

programs.title: Maddie & Triggs
programs.desc: Triggs' favourite teddy is a bit stinky and needs a wash, but poor Triggs is worried and doesn't want to let go. Can Maddie help reassure him that everything will be okay?

programs.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
programs.desc: The Broccolisaurus need a haircut. Luckily, their florets are a Pea-Rex's favourite snack!

programs.title: Play School
programs.desc: Abi & Zindzi learn how to make a wall cake for Humpty's birthday party! They create pictures with shapes for party decorations and visit Banksy's preschool. Through The Windows, we look at how teachers help us learn and grow!

programs.title: Fireman Sam
programs.desc: Moose teaches the kids how to slowly cook potatoes outdoors, but their hunger makes them impatient and soon lunch is the least of their worries.

programs.title: Santiago of the Seas
programs.sub_title: Cecilia and the Magic Rubies / Under the Pirate Moon
programs.desc: Santi and crew go underwater to stop Escarlata La Pirata before she steals all the Magic Rubies from Giant Clam Reef! / It's a nighttime chase above and below the sea when Escarlata turns the moon into a fish.

programs.title: Bluey's Big Play
programs.desc: Bluey and Bingo pull out all the stops to try to get Dad off his phone in their first live stage show, brought to life by brilliant puppets and featuring brand new original music.

programs.title: Bananas In Pyjamas
programs.desc: The Bananas have to do something very important but they've forgotten what it is!

programs.title: Sesame Street
programs.desc: Fred the Flamingo is visiting Sesame Street for a family reunion. Elmo, Rudy, and Nina learn all about flamingos from why their smiles are upside down to how the colour of their feathers change from white to pink.

programs.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
programs.desc: Anthony is ready for a rock 'n' roll eisteddfod, but when he plays a song for The Wiggles it puts them to sleep. It's time to call Caterina, the rock 'n' roll ballerina she will be able to help!

programs.title: Andy and the Band
programs.desc: Odd Sock Henny Feathers is an egg-centric farmer whose chickens aren't laying eggs.  Armed with costumes, mini-cameras and a Chicken Translator, Andy and the Band investigate.
